{"code": "from scipy.stats import binomtest

# Compute response rates by arm
response_rate_control = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
response_rate_treatment = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()

# Compute difference in proportions
diff = response_rate_treatment - response_rate_control

# Compute 95% confidence interval using binomial proportion difference (Wald)
n_control = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'control'].shape[0]
n_treatment = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'treatment'].shape[0]

se_diff = ((response_rate_treatment * (1 - response_rate_treatment) / n_treatment) + 
           (response_rate_control * (1 - response_rate_control) / n_control)) ** 0.5

z = 1.96  # 95% CI
lower = diff - z * se_diff
upper = diff + z * se_diff

print(f"Control response rate: {response_rate_control:.4f}")
print(f"Treatment response rate: {response_rate_treatment:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (treatment - control): {diff:.4f}")
print(f"95% CI: [{lower:.4f}, {upper:.4f}]")"}
